summary: Opens straight in doing. User micha on v1.3.1 had every generation die with "Node 'Input_Seed' not found"; he reported it as 1.3.1 not fixing him, but his log proves MPI-427's fix worked - MpiNodes downloaded, extracted and stamped cleanly at 15:30:09 from github.com. The real cause is that he runs his own ComfyUI on the default 8188: our readiness check in routes/comfy.js:190 only asks whether ANYTHING answers /history on that port, and processState.activeComfyProcess is truthy from the moment we spawn, so the app adopted his ComfyUI - which has no MpiNodes - and dispatched into it. Proved by four dispatches answering 65ms, 46ms and 2.9s after the start request, when ComfyUI provably finishes its custom-node scan before it binds the port (main.py:508 before start_all at 542), plus the total absence of any Import times / Starting server line in either log. Fix is two parts: move COMFYUI_PORT to 48188 across the four LOCAL consumers (shared.js, comfyController serverAddress, memoryOps, and the main.js Origin spoof - missing that last one 403s every call), leaving the RunPod 8188 and the dev bench scripts alone; and refuse to adopt an engine we did not start, so a future collision is a plain message instead of a silent misdispatch.

Both halves built and verified. Local engine moved 8188 -> 48188 across the four literal sites (shared.js, comfyController serverAddress, memoryOps, main.js Origin spoof and both webRequest guards); RunPod's 8188 and the dev bench scripts untouched. /comfy/start now returns 409 rather than adopting a port it did not open. tests/comfy-port-lockstep.test.cjs holds the four literals in lockstep and was negative-controlled against five separate doctored sources. 329/329 node tests pass, eslint 0 errors. Live: the engine binds 48188 and serves 1862 classes with MpiInt registered; a repo-root harness got the 409 with the port occupied and 200 with it free, so the probe cannot lock anyone out. Reporter confirmed the diagnosis independently by turning his own ComfyUI off. Remaining: one full Electron run, because the Origin/CORS spoof only exercises inside Electron.

Shipped and user-validated. The user ran the app end to end: engine came up on 48188, a generation completed, and the ComfyUI UI loads at http://127.0.0.1:48188 - which exercises the Electron Origin/CORS spoof, the one surface the harness could not reach. Confirmed live on his machine: PID 24988 is the app's own engine on 48188 serving 1862 node classes with MpiInt registered, and 8188 is empty. Remote path proven isolated by grep rather than by a Pod spin - no file in the remote path reads COMFYUI_PORT at all, and the Pod runtime hardcodes its own 8188 in start.sh, so the MPI-203 dev door is unaffected. Pre-existing dead import noted, not touched: routes/projects.js imports COMFYUI_PORT and never uses it.
Archived out of board.columns.done to .agents/mpi-kanban/tasks/_archived/MPI-434/ (workspace preserved intact). mpi-archive run 2026-08-04.
